better.en: Deleting a conversation now removes its saved file history immediately, instead of keeping it for up to 30 days.
better.pt-BR: Excluir uma conversa agora apaga suas cópias de restauração na hora, em vez de guardá-las por até 30 dias.
better.de: Wenn du ein Gespräch löschst, werden seine gespeicherten Dateiversionen jetzt sofort entfernt, statt bis zu 30 Tage aufbewahrt.
better.es: Al borrar una conversación, sus copias de restauración se eliminan al momento, en vez de conservarse hasta 30 días.
better.fr: Supprimer une conversation efface désormais aussitôt ses copies de restauration, au lieu de les conserver jusqu’à 30 jours.

decisions: | R-next | 2026-11-05 | Deleting a conversation immediately purges its private restore points and completed redo copies. Keep shared versions needed by other conversations, working files and unfinished restore recovery. | Owner |
